name: other-flags-without-transient
branch: FLAG_ACTIVE | FLAG_ESCALATE | FLAG_NOALERTS (0x0001|0x0002|0x0004 = 0x0007) with FLAG_TRANSIENT unset: nonzero bitmask but none of the set bits overlap 0x0008, so the AND yields 0 (falsy) despite flags being nonzero — proves the check isolates the exact bit, not just truthiness of `flags`
